description: Where a closed runway's crosses go on a sketch of the field, as the airport marks it on the ground (AC 150/5340-1M, Standards for Airport Markings, Change 1, 12/23/2020; AIM 2-3-6). Permanently closed (NASR's runway remark, CLSD INDEFLY or PERMLY): an X at each end and at 1,000-ft intervals, and one each side of an open runway it crosses (AC 5.6; AIM 2-3-6d). Closed by NOTAM: an X only at each end (AC 5.7.1; AIM 2-3-6e), over the designation marking, 50 ft in (Figure A-3's 60-ft numerals 20 ft from the threshold), at least the X's own size in. A part closed by NOTAM, read from JO 7930.2's forms (RWY 09/27 E 500FT CLSD, RWY 27 FIRST 1000FT CLSD), is marked at the part's own ends; a part it cannot place is not drawn, and a closure between a taxiway and an end (CLSD BTN TWY A AND RWY END 20) closes the whole runway, as notam_subject's badge says. An X never lies on an open runway: one that would moves along the centre line clear of it. The FAA's Xs are yellow (Figure A-27); the colour is the app's.

runways.description: Every runway drawn, in the sketch's order.

ends.description: Its ends' designations as the card writes them, the first end first ("02", "20").

a.description: Its first end, feet east and north of a point of the field.

width_ft.description: Its width as drawn, in the same feet: the room an X keeps off it.

permanent.description: Closed for good: NASR's runway remark.

notams.description: The NOTAMs in force that close it or a part of it, as sent.

mark_ft.description: An X's half size as drawn, in the runways' feet.

runways.description: One for each runway asked, in its order.

closed.description: The parts closed, each from and to as fractions of the way from its first end; [[0, 1]] closed end to end; none open.

marks.description: Each X's centre on the centre line, as a fraction of the way from its first end.
